full.title: Full backups
full.help: If more than one schedule falls due at the same time, the job runs once: an active full takes priority over a synthetic full, and a synthetic full over the regular backup. While the job is disabled, these schedules don't run either.
full.description: Each full backup starts a new backup chain. Retention can delete an old chain only after a newer full exists, so a job with retention needs at least one of these schedules.
full.activeHint: Reads the VMs in full again. Takes the longest, and the new chain doesn't depend on earlier backups.
full.syntheticHint: Takes an incremental backup, then merges the chain into a new full inside the repository without reading the whole VM again.
full.lastDayNote: In months without day {{day}}, it runs on the last day of the month.
full.customNote: This schedule was set outside the console. Saving keeps it as it is unless you pick another one.
full.keptWhenOff: Off. The job keeps its settings ({{schedule}}) for when you turn it back on.
full.syntheticUnsupported: {{repository}} can't merge backup chains, so each synthetic full runs as an active full instead.

errors.required: Retention is set, so turn on at least one full backup schedule (active or synthetic).
errors.activeDays: Pick at least one day for the active full backup.
errors.syntheticDays: Pick at least one day for the synthetic full backup.

full.syntheticOverridden: This runs at the same time as the active full backup, which takes priority — so the merge would never run. Move one of them to a different day or time.
full.syntheticOverriddenDays: On {{days}} the active full backup runs at the same time and takes priority, so no merge happens those days. Move one of them to a different day or time.
full.syntheticOverriddenDayOfMonth: On day {{day}} of the month the active full backup runs at the same time and takes priority, so no merge happens that day. Move one of them to a different day or time.
full.syntheticSameDayEvery: An active full backup runs on the same day, at a different time. It starts a new chain, so the merge has nothing to merge yet or is replaced hours later. Move one of them to another day.
full.syntheticSameDays: An active full backup also runs on {{days}}, at a different time. It starts a new chain, so the merge on that day has nothing to merge yet or is replaced hours later. Move one of them to another day.
full.syntheticSameDayOfMonth: An active full backup also runs on day {{day}} of the month, at a different time. It starts a new chain, so the merge that day has nothing to merge yet or is replaced hours later. Move one of them to another day.

opt.appAwareHint: VSS & pre-freeze scripts for consistent SQL/Exchange
opt.appAwareHelp: Quiesces the OS and databases via VSS before the snapshot, so the backup is transaction-consistent (no half-written records).
opt.compressionHelp:
Allows you to adjust the compression level to balance backup size, processing speed, and CPU usage.
0 = no compression, fastest processing
9 = more data savings, higher CPU usage
opt.compressionHint: Lower compression levels are faster, higher levels save more space and bandwidth. Default is 3.
opt.encryptionKeyCustomHint: You hold the key. Restore points written with it can be recovered on any AltaStor appliance, even if this one and its catalog are gone.
opt.encryptionKeyKeep: Leave it empty to keep the key this job already uses.
opt.encryptionKeyEscrow: Store this key outside the appliance now. Backups written with it can't be restored without it, and AltaStor won't show it again.
opt.encryptionKeyReplaces: This replaces the job's current key: restore points already written keep the key they were written with.

encryptionKeyError.empty: Enter a key, or generate one.
encryptionKeyError.whitespace: A key can't start or end with a space — the appliance stores it without one, so it wouldn't be the key you saved.
encryptionKeyError.tooSimple: Mix at least three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols — or generate a key.

create.gfsHelp: Grandfather-father-son (GFS): keep extra weekly, monthly, and yearly copies for long-term archival, on top of your day-to-day restore points.
create.gfsDescription: Optional archival copies kept beyond the regular retention above. Leave at 0 to skip.
create.gfsEnabledHelp: Suspends or resumes GFS archiving without touching the counts below. While suspended, no new weekly/monthly/yearly copies are marked and existing archival points age out under the regular retention above.
create.gfsEnabledHint: Weekly, monthly, and yearly copies are marked and kept.
create.gfsEnabledNoCounts: Set at least one count below for archival copies to be kept.
create.gfsSuspendedHint: Archiving is suspended. The counts below are kept for when you resume it.
